chemistry_cluster_definition.fingerprint: precomputed 2048-bit ECFP columns from the source table
chemistry_cluster_definition.ecfp_cluster: sha1 of the bit vector (bit-identical fingerprints)
chemistry_cluster_definition.source: built in-process from the source table

provenance_state.definition: every row of the shared cohort; no provenance-based row filter is applied in Experiment B, because the acquisition contrast is within-cohort

preprocessing.imputation: median + missing indicator, fitted inside the fold
preprocessing.sample_weights: group_balanced_weights on the training rows' ecfp_cluster

split_definition.fold_algorithm: gen5 seeded_group_kfold: shuffle unique group labels, deal round-robin
split_definition.acquisition_rng: default_rng([split_seed, fold, policy_code, draw, 606060607]) — budget deliberately excluded so the curve is nested within a draw

B1.statement: at equal row budget, DIVERSITY beats DEPTH

B2.statement: the DIVERSITY advantage is larger on hard chemistry than overall
B2.pass_condition: gain at hard_vs_BASEtrain_nn<0.4 > gain overall, both CI95 low > 0

B3.statement: the DEPTH curve slope between the two largest budgets is within noise of zero
